greeting.text: Huh…? Wait… is that you? From high school!

lines.text: Wow, it's been ages. How many years has it been?
I live around here now. You're in this area too?
You remember that kid from our class? They got married.
We should grab a meal sometime. For real.
Did you change your number? I couldn't find you in the group chat.
You haven't changed one bit, seriously.
Oh, I was in the middle of grocery shopping, haha.

flushRemark.text: You're turning red, haha. Same as ever.

closers.satisfied: So good to see you! Keep in touch~
closers.parried: Yeah, yeah, let's definitely meet up next time!
closers.endured: Anyway, great seeing you. Take care~
closers.sos: Oh, you've got a call, get it! Text me~
